name: Miners Rest Renewable Energy Integration Precinct data centre
notes: Proposed integrated regional data centre and renewable energy precinct at Miners Rest, about 10 km from Ballarat. ASX/trade reports describe 10-100 MW potential; capacity_mw records the announced minimum. City of Ballarat stated on 2026-07-15 that no formal planning application had been lodged yet.

name: Eureka DC Ballarat
notes: Regional colocation data centre in Ballarat CBD; operator page says the facility was constructed in 2017 and offers colocation with diverse fibre connectivity. Public source does not state total MW capacity.

name: Energy Estate Digital Bass Coast energy and infrastructure precinct
notes: Energy Estate Digital describes a network of regional energy and infrastructure precincts intended to host large-scale data centers; DCD reported that active development locations include Bass Coast, Victoria. No site, capacity, or planning approval details found in public sources.
